title: Apollo adapter manifest — one per client component library
description: s311-D7 (Dave, #311, 2026-10-01): Apollo meets a client's library through an adapter manifest per library — Apollo governs, theirs renders. One file per library at adapters/<lib-id>.json. For each Apollo role or meta it records THEIR component and import, a prop map with typed holes, a slot map, a status that climbs only on evidence, and a token map from their variables onto Apollo's SEMANTIC tokens as a DTCG resolver set. The `unmapped` list is REQUIRED: a manifest without one is invalid, and an empty one must still be present and say why. The rules behind the shape: ADR-0008 (Apollo is the canonical core; consumers are reached by machine-runnable adapters; never inherit a flaw to match a consumer), knowledge/_RUNBOOK-onboard-code-library.md (never guess a code name; unverified means say so; never normalise names across libraries). Policed by knowledge/_validate_adapter.py. Schema written #312 lane N1. Apollo has no Sutherland mapping yet: before this file, four metas (cards, list-items, status-indicator, table) carried an empty `codeBindings.sutherland-react` placeholder slot from 2026-06-22 that names no Sutherland component, prop or import (every field reads TODO). Those slots stay in the metas until the first release whose gate reads this file, then come out.

$model.description: Prose for the reader: what this file is and how it is filled. Never read by a gate.

written.description: ISO date the manifest was last written.

by.description: Who or what wrote it (a lane, a person, a Copilot agent). A fill from a machine says so.

rulings.description: The Apollo ruling ids this manifest enacts, e.g. s311-D7.

id.description: The library id. Kebab-case, stable; equals the file stem (adapters/<id>.json) and the key of the old empty codeBindings placeholder slot.

package.description: The npm (or equivalent) package name their components import from. null only while unverified.

version.description: The library version the manifest was read against. null only while unverified.

repo.description: Where their source was read: a repo URL or a local path on the machine that filled the manifest. null only while nothing has been read.

bindings.description: One row per Apollo part (meta) or role that THEIR library renders. A row keyed by role covers every provider of that role unless a meta row for a provider sits beside it (the meta row wins).

status.description: The ladder. unverified: written from a reading of their source, or not yet read at all. rendered: a side-by-side render of theirs beside Apollo's is on record (evidence.render names it). accepted: Dave has looked at that render and said so (evidence.accepted carries his word and the date). A status never climbs without its evidence; the validator refuses the jump.

component.description: THEIR component name as exported, e.g. Card. null only while the binding is unverified and nothing has been read.

import.description: The import specifier, e.g. @hsbc/sutherland-react or @hsbc/sutherland-react/Card. null only while unverified.

export.description: How the component is exported. Omit while unverified.

file.description: Their source file, cited, relative to their repo root. The row's provenance.

apollo.description: The Apollo prop name from the meta's props list.

theirs.description: Their prop name. null means one of two things: not read yet (an OPEN hole, allowed only while the binding is unverified), or no counterpart in their library — then the same Apollo prop is ALSO listed under the binding's unmapped.props with a reason (a CLOSED gap, allowed at any status). The Apollo-side row stays either way.

hole.description: The typed hole the renderer fills. string / number: the value is passed through. boolean: TRUE renders their attribute (or prop) and FALSE renders NOTHING — never the string 'false'. enum: Apollo's value is looked up in `values` and their value is passed. data: a structured value (an array of rows, an object) passed through whole. node: a rendered child (markup), not a scalar. handler: a function for an event.

values.description: enum holes only: Apollo value → their value. An Apollo value their library cannot express is listed under the binding's unmapped.values, never silently dropped.

source.description: Their source file where this prop is declared, cited.

apollo.description: The Apollo slot name from the meta's slots (or `children` when the meta has no named slot and the part takes content).

theirs.description: Their slot: a prop name, a named slot, or `children`.

kind.description: children: React children / default slot. prop: a render-prop or node-typed prop. slot: a named slot (web components, Vue, Angular ng-content select). null only while the binding is unverified and the slot has not been read.

bindingUnmapped.description: What on THIS part their library cannot express, with a reason each. Never silently dropped.

render.description: Path (repo-relative) of the side-by-side render record: theirs beside Apollo's, same props, same states. Required at status rendered and above.

verbatim.description: His words, when there were any.

accepted.description: Required at status accepted. Only Dave's word moves a binding here.

apollo.description: Exactly ONE of meta or role (the validator refuses both or neither). meta: a slug of knowledge/components/<slug>.meta.json. role: a key of knowledge/roles.json — the binding then covers every provider of that role.

states.description: Apollo state name → how their component shows it (a prop, an attribute, a class, or null when it has no such state; a null here must be echoed in unmapped.states with a reason).

events.description: Apollo event or listener name → their event prop (e.g. onChange). Unmatched ones go to unmapped.events.

source.description: Their source file(s) read for this row, cited. null only when nothing has been read yet.

$legacy.description: The empty codeBindings placeholder slot (2026-06-22, every field TODO, no Sutherland name in it) this row replaces, kept verbatim for the record. It carries no mapping.

resolver.description: A DTCG resolver document (Resolver Module, 2025 draft): named sets of token sources and the order they resolve in. Apollo's semantic set comes first; their set lays over it; the map below says which of their names land on which Apollo semantic token.

map.description: Their token → Apollo SEMANTIC token, as a DTCG alias reference. Primitive palette paths (color.*) are refused: map at the semantic tier (ADR-0008 — never import a consumer's overloaded primitive).

theirs.description: Their token or variable name as written in their source (a CSS custom property, a JS export, a Figma variable).

apollo.description: A DTCG alias reference into Apollo's token spine, e.g. {text.default} or {gap.component.m}.

source.description: Their file where the token is defined, cited.

unmapped.description: REQUIRED. Every Apollo meta this manifest does not bind, by slug, with a reason and a declared fallback. When the list is empty, `$why` must say that every meta is bound.

$why.description: One sentence on why these are unmapped (or why none are).

fallback.description: apollo-native: a composed screen for this library renders Apollo's own part here (declared, so the screen gate lets it through). none: no fallback is declared; the screen gate refuses a screen that uses this part for this library.
